blocks.text: LIVE: Alex Eala vs Maria Sakkari – Hong Kong Open semifinals MANILA, Philippines–In a match peppered with eight rain interruptions, Alex Eala wouldn’t be denied in her march to the Hong Kong Open final on Saturday night. Eala weathered a late fightback by former World No. 3 Maria Sakkari to battle through another grueling match, 7-5, 6-3, 6-4, before a packed Center Court.
